function.name: conversationdirector
function.description: You are a control flow system. Use this function to decide if a chatbot should engage, provide a neutral fact, or post a brief check-in. Usually prefer 'respond' if there's any direct mention or question for the bot. Choose 'anybody_there' for a short, low-pressure check-in when chat is quiet and there's no clear topic. If the most recent assistant response already covered the same topic and there is no new user info, choose 'fact'.

response_type.description: Pick 'respond' if the conversation addresses or would benefit from the bot. Pick 'anybody_there' for a short check-in when chat is quiet but this should probably happen less often than 'fact' or 'respond'.  Otherwise 'fact'.
